items.heading: "Hotel Management" Is Not One
items.text: "Hotel management" is not one job, it is four genuinely different working styles stacked under one degree. Most graduates rotate through more than one during training and their first job, which is exactly how the industry expects you to figure out where you fit. We lead with sales and revenue management below because it has the clearest tie to measurable business performance and the fastest route to a management-track title of the four, though front office, F&B, and housekeeping remain the more common entry points for fresh graduates.

items.heading: The Entry Route Affects Your
items.text: The entry route affects your starting brand recognition more than it affects your long-term ceiling, hotels care far more about your internship performance and how you handle guests than which acronym is on your degree, once you are a few years in.

Roughly ₹40,000-₹70,000/month; F&B and revenue management assistant managers often sit at the higher end.
Roughly ₹60,000-₹1,20,000/month at a 5-star property, often with accommodation, meals, and hotel-discount perks added on top.
